company.name: Extend, Inc.
company.shortDescription: Extend is an AI-powered commerce platform that helps brands reward high-value customers, limit abuse, and protect margins.
company.description:
Extend helps brands turn shopper behavior into operational and financial advantage. Their platform transforms post-purchase customer data into real-time intelligence, allowing merchants to dynamically tailor policies and experiences across delivery, returns, exchanges, and product protection. By differentiating customers based on value and risk, Extend helps brands reward their best customers, reduce fraud and abuse, protect margins, and increase lifetime value — without manual intervention.

Getting started with Extend is easy. Seamlessly integrate using their robust APIs or commerce platform integrations like Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, and more. Their team works hand in hand to deliver positive customer experiences and increased margins for retailers across all verticals.

Extend was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $260,000,000, or 81.15% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $19,328,329 to $1,600,000,000, a 82.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
